---
title: "Installing R and RStudio"
---

Install **R** first, then **RStudio Desktop**.

## 1. Install R

1. Open the [official CRAN website](https://cran.r-project.org/).
2. Select your operating system: Windows, macOS, or Linux.
3. Download the recommended version of R and install it using the default settings.

## 2. Install RStudio Desktop

1. Open the [RStudio Desktop download page](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
2. Download the free version for your operating system.
3. Install the application and launch RStudio.

## 3. Check your installation

When you launch RStudio, you will see several panes. Find the **Console** pane. The console is where R accepts commands and displays results.

1. Click after the `>` prompt in the console.
2. Type the following command:

```r
1 + 1
```

3. Press **Enter**.

You should see:

```text
> 1 + 1
[1] 2
```

The result `2` confirms that R is working in RStudio. The `[1]` before the result is normal.
